items.raw_snippet:
Topic / 话题

Artificial Intelligence (AI) was not intended to have human-like cognitive abilities and personality. AI (or narrow AI) was rather to be used in accomplishing specific pre-learned problem solving or reasoning tasks (such as asking Siri “what’s the time?” or “which restaurant is top-rated in Sanlitun?”)

人工智能(AI)的初衷并不是拥有类似人类的认知能力和个性。人工智能(或狭义人工智能)更倾向于用于完成特定的预先学习的问题解决或推理任务(比如问Siri“现在几点了?”或“三里屯哪家餐厅最好?”) [...] Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), on the other hand, is a hypothetical (strong AI) ability of an intelligent agent to understand or learn any intellectual task that a human being can perform. This would require the intelligent agent to have self-awareness and consciousness.

另一方面，人工一般智能(AGI)是一种假设的(强人工智能)能力，智能代理能够理解或学习人类能够执行的任何智能任务。这就要求智能体具有自我意识和意识。 [...] 49￥ (场地费+报名费)
